title: Platforms
description: The list people choose from when they add a social account. Adding one here makes it available immediately — no deployment needed.

add.title: Add a platform
add.name: Name
add.nameHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, dots and hyphens. This is the stable identifier and cannot be changed later.
add.duplicate: A platform with that name already exists.

retire.title: Retire this platform?
retire.message: It disappears from the list people choose from. Existing accounts are kept and keep showing on public profiles — nothing is deleted. You can bring it back by adding it again with the same name.
